thread:
Mike (Support): urgent escalation — Solterra tenant failing activation, renewal due in 30d. Customer can't finish onboarding; 403 on /api/v1/provision. Raising to CS for priority handling. Ticket: INC-4891. @Sara @Lena please advise next steps.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-4891 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4891

Sara (CS): On it. I'll own the handoff. Need root cause + temporary unblock. Can you paste the failing request + timestamp?

Mike (Support): logs below. Repro via curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-***' -d '{"org":"solterra","plan":"dedicated"}'``` Response 403: ```{
  "error":"entitlement_missing",
  "detail":"Org not found in entitlement service"
}``` Happened 2026-03-21T10:12:03Z. Customer tried twice.

Raj (SE): Likely entitlement sync issue between billing and entitlements — org id mismatch. Quick workaround: manual tenant create in admin console + map customer org id to entitlement service. I can create a one-off mapping. /cc @Sara

Sara (CS): Proposed comms plan:
1) Immediate: push a "we're on it" note to customer within 30m (Lena).
2) Short-term unblock: manual provisioning by SE (Raj) within 4h.
3) Enablement call + walkthrough within 24h (Sara).
4) Follow-up: RCA and confirm permanent fix + notify renewal team.
Owners: Lena (customer comms), Raj (SE mapping), Mike (support logs), Sara (CS owner).

Lena (Customer Success Manager): I'll send the "we're on it" message now. Draft: "Hi Alex — we see an activation error and are prioritizing this. We'll provision your tenant manually ASAP and schedule a walkthrough for tomorrow. Expect an update in 4 hours." :white_check_mark:

Mike (Support): I can perform additional logs or try rotated API key if needed. One note: the customer has a nonstandard org id with uppercase letters; entitlement service lowercases ids — mismatch may be causing the error.

Raj (SE): Confirmed. I've started the mapping job. ETA 90m for manual mapping + verification. After mapping, I can run smoke tests: ```GET /v1/tenants/solterra/status -> 200 OK```

Sara (CS): Booked enablement slot with Alex for 2026-03-22 09:00 PT. Agenda: tenant access, onboarding checklist, how to use tokens. I'll prepare quick-start doc. Also, because renewal is in 30d, recommend we mark as "high risk" in the renewal tracker and pause automated renewal emails until after activation.

Mike (Support): I'll update INC-4891 with the mapping steps and logs. If mapping fails, fallback: temporary org alias and manual token issuance.

Lena (Customer Success Manager): Sent initial note to customer. Alex replied: "Thanks — appreciate the quick response. Waiting on your update."

Sara (CS): Thanks team. I'll update the renewal tracker, confirm manual provision completion, then close the loop. Reassigning follow-ups in the ticket now. :thumbsup:
